title: Concept: Composer dependency pinned to a development branch
description: composer.json declares a `dev-…` constraint, which follows a VCS branch, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The branch moves, so a package install on any day can differ from the one reviewed, and the install pulls from the VCS rather than Packagist.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: The branch moves, so a package install on any day can differ from the one reviewed, and the install pulls from the VCS rather than Packagist.
